# Workflow: Handoff

Use this workflow when work crosses a thread boundary.

## Template

```text
Source thread:
Target thread:
Current conclusion:
Confirmed facts:
Impact:
Do not repeat:
Questions for target thread:
Suggested next step:
```

## Rules

- Do not make the target thread's decision.
- Include only confirmed facts and clearly labeled inference.
- Keep the handoff short enough to paste into a new Codex thread.
